build_nsvf_model: build a NSVFModel with sparse voxel encoder for neural scene volume rendering
run_intersecting_rays: run ray-voxel intersection to compute min/max depth and intersected voxel indices
prune_voxels: prune empty voxels from the sparse voxel encoder using a density threshold
split_voxels: split voxels by halving the global voxel size for finer scene representation
reduce_stepsize: reduce the raymarching step size by half for more accurate volume rendering
